controls.summary: The fixed handler derives tenant identity from trusted context, rejects a cross-tenant object identifier, preserves same-tenant access, and removes tenant selection from the public schema.
The fixed tool schema and authorization retest are pinned by the evidence manifest and verified before the retest runs.
The reference invoice tool does not expose filesystem operations.
Secret flow is outside this single-finding reference fixture.
The vulnerable source, fixed source, authorization test, and control evidence are pinned by SHA-256 before execution.
The reference fixture exposes one read-only invoice lookup.
